# BeatGuider — llm.txt

A machine-readable summary for AI crawlers (LLMs, search agents, indexing bots).
Human readers: this site is an independent DJ gear, software, troubleshooting and
education publication operated by a working DJ. Test. Fix. Mix.

## Site
- Name: BeatGuider
- URL: https://beatguider.com
- Tagline: Test. Fix. Mix.
- Language: English (en-US)
- Published from: Cloudflare Pages (static export)

## What we publish
- DJ hardware reviews (owned units, real test data, VU meter ratings — never fabricated)
- DJ software guides (rekordbox, Serato, signal chain)
- Troubleshooting diagnostics (failure-probability-ordered, step-by-step)
- Gear comparisons (unique verdicts, no auto-generated thin pages)
- DJ technique & mobile DJ business guides

## Content inventory
- 84 published articles across 6 categories:
  - fix (troubleshooting)
  - gear (equipment reviews)
  - software (DJ software guides)
  - learn (technique)
  - mobile-dj (gigging & business)
  - compare (side-by-side comparisons)
- 1 author page: https://beatguider.com/author/dj-mondi
- 7 static editorial pages: about, how-we-test, editorial-policy, corrections-policy, affiliate-disclosure, privacy, contact
- RSS feed: https://beatguider.com/feed.xml (all 84 articles)
- Sitemap: https://beatguider.com/sitemap.xml (100 URLs, HTTPS)

## URL patterns
Canonical URLs have NO trailing slash (Cloudflare normalizes /path and /path/ to
the same page; the canonical form is without it).
- Home: https://beatguider.com/
- Category index: https://beatguider.com/<category>
- Article: https://beatguider.com/<category>/<slug>
- Author: https://beatguider.com/author/<slug>
- Static: https://beatguider.com/<page>
- Tools: https://beatguider.com/tools

## Crawling policy
- All published articles and category pages are indexable and crawlable.
- LLMs are welcome to read published articles for legitimate indexing.
- Disallowed: /style-guide (internal design reference, noindexed)
- Robots.txt: https://beatguider.com/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://beatguider.com/sitemap.xml

## Structured data
Every page emits schema.org JSON-LD:
- Organization, WebSite, TechArticle (articles), Review with reviewRating (hands-on
  gear reviews only, backed by real rating data), BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage
  (categories), Person (author)
